strings.d1.s0.name: Red Square
strings.d1.s0.tips: Empty in the morning; see St. Basil's and the GUM facades. Lenin's Mausoleum is open Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday 10:00-13:00.
strings.d1.s1.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
strings.d1.s1.tips: Onion-domed cathedral; narrow stairs and icons inside.
strings.d1.s2.name: Moscow Kremlin & Armoury
strings.d1.s2.tips: Kremlin cathedrals plus the Armoury (Fabergé eggs). Book online 2 weeks ahead; closed Thursday; Armoury entry is timed.
strings.d1.s3.name: GUM Gastronom No.1
strings.d1.s3.tips: GUM's Soviet-themed food hall; ice cream (plombir) and a cafeteria.
strings.d1.s4.name: Zaryadye Park Floating Bridge
strings.d1.s4.tips: Modern park next to the Kremlin; a bridge over the river and an ice cave. Go at sunset.
strings.d1.b0.name: Stolovaya 57 GUM
strings.d1.b1.name: State Historical Museum
strings.d1.b1.tips: The red museum on Red Square; a fallback if you have no Kremlin ticket.
strings.d2.s0.name: Tretyakov Gallery
strings.d2.s0.tips: Russian painting: Repin, Vrubel and icons (Rublev's Trinity). Closed Monday.
strings.d2.s1.name: Zamoskvorechye Streets
strings.d2.s1.tips: Old merchant district; Pyatnitskaya Street and its churches.
strings.d2.s2.name: Lepim i Varim Pyatnitskaya
strings.d2.s2.tips: Handmade pelmeni (dumplings) with a choice of fillings.
strings.d2.s3.name: Muzeon Park & Krymskaya Naberezhnaya
strings.d2.s3.tips: Soviet sculpture park (including the toppled Dzerzhinsky) and the riverside.
strings.d2.s4.name: Gorky Park
strings.d2.s4.tips: Ice rink in winter (skate hire available) and hot tea.
strings.d2.b0.name: Cafe Pushkin
strings.d2.b0.tips: Aristocratic Russian cuisine on Tverskoy; reserve ahead.
strings.d2.b1.name: Garage Museum of Contemporary Art
strings.d2.b1.tips: Contemporary art in Gorky Park, in a building by Rem Koolhaas.
strings.d3.s0.name: Komsomolskaya Metro Station
strings.d3.s0.tips: Baroque station with mosaics; start of the metro tour (use a Troika card).
strings.d3.s1.name: Mayakovskaya Metro Station
strings.d3.s1.tips: Art deco steel arches and ceiling mosaics.
strings.d3.s2.name: Ploshchad Revolyutsii Metro
strings.d3.s2.tips: Bronze statues; rub the dog's nose.
strings.d3.s3.name: Arbat Street
strings.d3.s3.tips: Pedestrian street with matryoshka dolls, street musicians and Pushkin's house.
strings.d3.s4.name: Mari Vanna Moscow
strings.d3.s4.tips: Russian cuisine in a grandmother's-home setting; borscht and pelmeni.
strings.d3.b0.name: Varenichnaya No.1 Arbat
strings.d3.b1.name: Pushkin Museum of Fine Arts
strings.d3.b1.tips: Impressionists and Egypt; an alternative to Arbat.
strings.d4.s0.name: VDNKh
strings.d4.s0.tips: Soviet exhibition of achievements: the Friendship of Peoples fountain and the Kosmos pavilion (paid museum). The grounds are free.
strings.d4.s1.name: Museum of Cosmonautics
strings.d4.s1.tips: Beneath the Monument to the Conquerors of Space; Gagarin and Sputnik.
strings.d4.s2.name: VDNKh Pavilion Cafeteria
strings.d4.s2.tips: Soviet stolovaya (canteen) inside the exhibition grounds; shashlik.
strings.d4.s3.name: Ostankino TV Tower
strings.d4.s3.tips: 540 m tower; bring your passport. Glass floor, timed entry.
strings.d4.b0.name: Moskovskoye Nebo VDNKh
strings.d4.b1.name: Botanical Garden VDNKh
strings.d4.b1.tips: Botanical garden beside the exhibition grounds; an alternative to the tower.
strings.d5.s0.name: Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour by train from Yaroslavsky station. The heart of Russian Orthodoxy: blue and gold domes, the shrine of St. Sergius. Bring a headscarf.
strings.d5.s1.name: Lavra Trapeznaya Canteen
strings.d5.s2.name: Sergiev Posad Toy Museum
strings.d5.s2.tips: The birthplace of the matryoshka; wooden toys.
strings.d5.s3.name: Blinnaya Gora Viewpoint
strings.d5.s3.tips: Postcard view of the monastery from a hilltop.
strings.d5.b0.name: Gostevaya Izba Sergiev Posad
strings.d5.b0.tips: Lunch in a traditional Russian izba (log house).
strings.d5.b1.name: Abramtsevo Estate
strings.d5.b1.tips: Artists' colony estate; a museum alternative on the way.
strings.d6.s0.name: Kolomenskoye
strings.d6.s0.tips: Riverside tsar's estate: the Church of the Ascension (UNESCO), a replica wooden palace and apple orchards.
strings.d6.s1.name: Kolomenskoye Tea House
strings.d6.s1.tips: Samovar tea and blini in the park.
strings.d6.s2.name: Moscow City Federation Tower Panorama 360
strings.d6.s2.tips: Observation deck on the 89th floor; free ice cream, views over the skyscraper district.
strings.d6.s3.name: Khachapuri Restaurant Bolshaya Gruzinskaya
strings.d6.s3.tips: Georgian chain with khachapuri (cheese bread) and khinkali (dumplings), a Moscow favourite.
strings.d6.s4.name: Patriarch's Ponds
strings.d6.s4.tips: Bulgakov's pond; cafes and an evening stroll.
strings.d6.b0.name: Sakhli Georgian Restaurant
strings.d6.b1.name: Novodevichy Convent
strings.d6.b1.tips: Red-walled convent and a cemetery of famous figures; an alternative to the skyscrapers.
strings.d7.s0.name: Bolshoi Theatre
strings.d7.s0.tips: Facade and square; performance tickets sell out months ahead. Photograph it in the morning.
strings.d7.s1.name: Eliseevsky / Tverskaya
strings.d7.s1.tips: Tverskaya Street: coffee and souvenirs (Christmas atmosphere in winter).
strings.d7.s2.name: Cafe Pushkin Konditerskaya
strings.d7.s2.tips: Pushkin's pastry shop; cake and coffee for a farewell.
strings.d7.s3.name: Aeroexpress Belorussky
strings.d7.s3.tips: Aeroexpress to Sheremetyevo takes 35 minutes; farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Dr. Zhivago Restaurant
strings.d7.b0.tips: Stylish Soviet-style breakfast at the National Hotel.
strings.d7.b1.name: Bunker-42
strings.d7.b1.tips: Cold War bunker tour; an alternative to the Bolshoi.
strings.note0: Use a Troika card for the metro (the stations are among the most beautiful in the world and worth a tour); Yandex Go for taxis. Aeroexpress serves the airports.
strings.note1: Visa: Turkish citizens can stay 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Foreign bank cards do not work (2026), so carry cash roubles or a MIR card; there is no Google Pay.
strings.note2: Winter brings -10°C and snow. Red Square has an ice rink and a Christmas market (December-February); try a banya (Sanduny), and the metro is warm.
strings.note3: Pelmeni 400-600 RUB, Georgian restaurant 1,500-2,500, stolovaya 300; tip 10%.
strings.note4: Book the Kremlin and Armoury online 2 weeks ahead. Lenin's Mausoleum is open Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings; expect a 30-minute queue.
strings.note5: In churches women cover their heads and men remove their hats; photography may be banned inside.
strings.transit.name: Troika Card
strings.transit.why_chosen: Covers metro, bus and tram; the metro stations are among the most beautiful in the world.
